skill.name: ngx-funnel-criteria
skill.description: Evaluation criteria for NGX funnel audits covering visual design, value clarity, copy, UX, and conversion elements.
skill.summary: Audit NGX landing pages, checkouts, and conversion flows with a structured scoring rubric.
skill.author: 270aldo

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt-injection language, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior.

content.value_statement: Funnel reviews can become inconsistent when teams use different scoring standards. This skill provides a structured NGX rubric for visual, UX, copy, and conversion audits.
actual_capabilities: Scores NGX funnel pages across five weighted criteria groups.
Checks visual identity against NGX color, background, card, border, and shadow standards.
Reviews value clarity, headline structure, and visible differentiation.
Evaluates copy against NGX messaging rules and prohibited claims.
Checks UX details such as CTA placement, form length, mobile layout, and touch targets.
Provides page-specific checklists for lead magnets, product landings, and checkouts.
limitations: It provides criteria only and does not inspect websites automatically.
It does not replace analytics, heatmaps, or live conversion testing.
It assumes the NGX brand rules in the skill file are current.
It does not include executable code, browser automation, or network checks.

use_cases.title: Review a Lead Magnet Landing Page
use_cases.description: Apply the NGX checklist before publishing a lead capture page.

use_cases.title: Audit Checkout Friction
use_cases.description: Check pricing clarity, payment visibility, trust signals, and support placement.

use_cases.title: Standardize Funnel QA
use_cases.description: Use the same scoring rubric across design, copy, and conversion reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Score
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this NGX landing page using the funnel criteria. Give a score and list the top three fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Checkout Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this checkout flow against the NGX checkout checklist. Focus on friction, trust, pricing, and CTA clarity.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of a purchase flow

prompt_templates.title: Copy and UX Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this funnel page for NGX copy rules, value clarity, mobile UX, and conversion elements. Separate critical and minor issues.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritized Funnel Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an NGX funnel audit report with scores by category, evidence, impact, and a prioritized remediation plan.

output_examples.input: Audit a product landing page for ASCEND using the NGX criteria.
output_examples.output: The page scores 78 out of 100. Main gaps are weak differentiation, limited proof, and a CTA that appears too late.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout page before launch.
output_examples.output: The checkout passes price clarity and payment visibility. It needs stronger guarantee placement and clearer support access.

output_examples.input: Summarize red flags from a lead magnet page.
output_examples.output: The main red flags are a long form, no preview of the lead magnet, and a vague CTA.

best_practices: Provide screenshots or page text so the audit can cite visible evidence.
Score each category before writing recommendations.
Prioritize fixes that affect CTA visibility, form friction, and value clarity.
anti_patterns: Do not use the rubric as a substitute for live performance data.
Do not ignore mobile usability when desktop design looks correct.
Do not make absolute marketing claims without evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits NGX landing pages, checkouts, and conversion flows against a structured funnel rubric.

faq.question: Does it run automated browser tests?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only rubric and does not execute code or browse pages.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it score a page numerically?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill defines a 100-point scoring model across five audit categories.

faq.question: What page types are covered?
faq.answer: It includes checklists for lead magnet landings, product landings, and checkout pages.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide page copy, screenshots, layout notes, or observed UX issues for a useful audit.
